title: A salamander with no lungs
text: The Tehachapi slender salamander lives only in California, in isolated areas of the Piute and Tehachapi Mountains in Kern County. It is about 3 inches long and dark brown, with coppery red and silver speckles. It has no lungs and breathes through its skin, which it must keep moist. It lives in damp leaf litter and comes out during high humidity or rain.
